description: Uva Provincial Council - Order under statute No. 4/2010 of Uva Provincial Co-operative Employees Commission to appoint Chairman and members
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists personnel appointments (Chairman and Members of the Uva Provincial Cooperative Employees Commission) with their names, addresses, and dates of appointment. While the Minister's portfolio is described in detail, this is part of the signatory's identification and does not constitute a detailed description of the responsibilities assigned to the appointed individuals themselves. The core content is solely about naming people for positions without detailing their specific duties or portfolio responsibilities, making it a People Gazette.
